name: Ciwen Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ciwen Media Co.,Ltd. engages in the film, television dramas, game products, channel promotions, and artist management businesses in China and internationally. It offers online dramas, film and television production, distribution and related services, film distribution and related services, mobile casual game business and channel promotion business, artist management and related services revenue, online movies, online micro-dramas, interactive dramas, mini-program short dramas and offline IP derivatives.
